reports.title: Lear Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; Year-Over-Year Growth in Revenue, Core Operating Earnings, Net Income and Earnings per Share

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: We adjusted our 2026 financial outlook to reflect changing production schedules for key platforms and their impact on our business. We are maintaining our full year outlook for core operating earnings as we anticipate our strong operational execution and the additional savings from our restructuring actions will offset the impacts from lower revenue and higher commodity and other input costs.

At the midpoint of our guidance range, we have assumed that full-year global industry production will be approximately 1% lower than in 2025 on a Lear sales-weighted basis. The industry volume assumptions underlying our 2026 financial outlook are derived from several sources, including internal estimates, customer production schedules and the most recent Mobility Global production estimates for our vehicle platforms.
Our outlook excludes any future impact of potential changes to tariffs or Company or industry-wide production disruptions.
